reveal_en: Every atom in your body, from the carbon in your cells to the iron in your blood, was forged in the heart of an ancient, exploding star.
reveal_zh: 你体内每个原子，从细胞的碳到血液的铁，都诞生于古老爆炸恒星的核心。
meaning_en: This cosmic lineage connects us to the universe's origin, making us literally children of the stars. It evokes wonder, humility, and a profound sense of belonging.
meaning_zh: 这种宇宙血统将我们与宇宙起源相连，使我们成为真正的星辰之子。它唤起惊奇、谦逊和深刻的归属感。

visual.color: Deep indigo, shimmering gold, faint nebulae
visual.motion: Slow, ethereal drift of luminous particles, subtle pulsating light
